title: Butcher's Crossing
desc: Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.

title: Jurassic Hunt
desc: In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

title: Bad Samaritan
desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

title: Rememory
desc: You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.
